# Crafity Lebanon

> Crafity Lebanon is a handmade crafts store offering macrame, resin art, candles, handmade soap, crochet, beads, gypsum art, gifts, souvenirs, and craft supplies in Lebanon.

## Main Website

* [Home](https://www.crafity-lb.com/): Handmade crafts, gifts, and supplies by Crafity Lebanon.
* [Sitemap](https://www.crafity-lb.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of public website pages for search engines and crawlers.

## Product Categories

* [Macrame](https://www.crafity-lb.com/category/macrame): Handmade macrame products.
* [Resin Art](https://www.crafity-lb.com/category/resin): Resin art creations and handmade decorative pieces.
* [Candles](https://www.crafity-lb.com/category/candles): Handmade candles.
* [Soap](https://www.crafity-lb.com/category/soap): Handmade natural soap.
* [Crochet](https://www.crafity-lb.com/category/crochet): Handmade crochet items.
* [Gypsum](https://www.crafity-lb.com/category/gypsum): Gypsum and concrete-style handmade art.
* [Beads](https://www.crafity-lb.com/category/beads): Beaded handmade accessories and products.
* [Giftbox](https://www.crafity-lb.com/category/giftbox): Gift boxes, souvenirs, and special handmade gifts.
* [Tools and Supplies](https://www.crafity-lb.com/category/supplies): Craft supplies and essential handmade materials.

## Collections

* [Best Sellers](https://www.crafity-lb.com/label/best-seller): Popular handmade products from Crafity Lebanon.
* [New Arrivals](https://www.crafity-lb.com/label/new-arrival): Recently added handmade products.
